note: Snapshot v2 — visibility, neighborhood, tighter toolbar. The 📋 button now mounts reliably with a requestAnimationFrame retry if header-controls is not ready, explicit font-size and line-height so the glyph never collapses, and appended to the end of the toolbar where the other tool buttons live. Right-click anywhere on the main chart now opens a context menu with 📋 Snapshot (±5 bars around cursor). Bar index resolved via Chart.js getElementsAtEventForMode. buildSnapshot now accepts an optional centerIdx so the snapshot can be the neighborhood of what the user is looking at, not just the tail. In compose mode the right-click menu also includes the existing Style which indicator items below the snapshot option. Toolbar tightened across the board so all buttons fit one row: header-controls gap 10px to 6px, interval-btn padding 7px-12px to 5px-9px and font 0.78rem to 0.74rem, load-btn padding 8px-20px to 6px-14px, symbol-input width 130px to 110px.
